title: Memory Fragments
content: The fragments are not data. They are memories, pressed into resonant crystal like flowers in a book — and they are not yours.
Right-click to analyze one. The first analysis teaches the Codex something new; every analysis pays research points.
Rift phantoms carry them. Vaults hoard them. The wrecks of the Machine Graveyard occasionally yield one to a careful pickaxe.
Whose memories are these? The Codex has no answer yet. The handwriting in the etched ratios and the voice in the fragments share certain... habits.
